Exceptional Development Opportunity ? Hillpark, Clarinbridge, Co. Galway (H91 XH33)
Pat Callanan Property Sales Ltd. are delighted to present Hillpark, Clarinbridge, Co. Galway to the market for sale by private treaty.
Ideally located in the heart of the highly sought-after village of Clarinbridge along Ireland's Wild Atlantic Way, this substantial property offers a rare opportunity to acquire a versatile holding with significant development potential.
Clarinbridge is renowned for its famous oyster beds, annual Oyster Festival, strong community spirit, and excellent local amenities, including schools, shops, cafés, restaurants, medical services, and sporting facilities. The village also benefits from convenient access to Galway City and surrounding areas.
The property comprises a spacious single-storey building and a separate two-storey apartment, extending to approximately 242 sq.m. in total. Currently benefiting from commercial planning permission, Hillpark presents a range of possibilities for prospective purchasers, including commercial, residential (subject to planning permission), investment, or mixed-use development.
Its prominent village-centre location makes it particularly suitable for a variety of uses, including medical or healthcare services, professional offices, childcare facilities, wellness practices, retail premises, cafés, or consultancy spaces.
Externally, the property offers ample parking, a secure gated rear yard with a raised seating area, and mature boundary planting.
Properties with this level of flexibility and potential in such a prime location rarely come to the market. Hillpark represents an outstanding opportunity for investors, developers, business owners, and owner-occupiers alike.
For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact Pat Callanan Property Sales Ltd. on 091 844818.
